meta.title: Sorry to see you go
meta.description: Tell us why you uninstalled Funlingo. Your feedback helps us build a better language learning experience.

form.title: What made you uninstall?
form.subtitle: One tap is enough. It goes straight to the team.
form.howLongLabel: How long did you use Funlingo? (optional)
form.emailLabel: Email (optional), so we can tell you when it's fixed

broken.label: Something wasn't working
broken.placeholder: Which site, and what happened? Even one line helps.

translations.label: Translations weren't good enough
translations.prompt: Which language pair, and which site?
translations.placeholder: e.g. English → Spanish on Netflix, translations were too literal…

platform.label: My streaming site isn't supported
platform.placeholder: e.g. Safari, Firefox, a specific streaming site…

missing.label: Missing a feature I needed
missing.placeholder: e.g. a language, a streaming service, a word list…

trying.label: Just trying it out / don't need it now
trying.prompt: Anything that would have made you keep it?
trying.placeholder: Tell us in your own words.

other.label: Something else
other.placeholder: Tell us in your own words.

thanks.title: Thanks, we got it.
thanks.recoverable: We ship fixes and new features every week. If you give Funlingo another try, this might already be sorted.
thanks.notRecoverable: Your feedback goes straight to the team. Thanks for taking the time.
thanks.emailNote: We'll email you at {email} when there's news.
